messages:
marco: quick heads-up — int3 bring-up (qbringup branch) is showing a quality dip specifically on codegen-style prompts. baseline vs int3: drop ~6-8% pass@1 on our code evals. need a small curation + golden update to verify whether this is model regress or tokenizer/quant artifact :eyes:

olivia: thanks for flagging. can you paste the failing prompt examples? are these long-context or short snippets?

marco: mostly long prompts (>= 512 tokens) with mixed natural language + code blocks. i dumped 200 examples to /tmp/int3_code_deltas.jsonl — lots of truncation-ish completions.

ben: i can run a quick stratified sample and push to label queue. prefer stratify by: language (py/js), length bucket, presence of inline backticks. target n=120 for human audit.

lina: before we run humans, suggest we update golden selection criteria — include an "edge_coverage" tag (tokenizer split variance > 0.12 OR many punctuation tokens). this will help surface tokenizer-sensitive prompts that break under int3 quant kernels.

sara: +1 to edge_coverage. can we codify selection? something like:
```sql
-- pick candidates for golden audit
select id from prompt_bank
where model_agnostic_score > 0.7
and (tokenizer_split_variance > 0.12 or has_code_block = true)
order by rand() limit 200;
```

olivia: nice. also add a dedupe threshold: fuzzy_jaccard < 0.85 to avoid near-duplicates. we saw many paraphrase collisions in prior audits.

marco: good call. ben — if you can seed the labeler with that sql, please add a small tag "int3-audit-apr2026" and set priority high. timeline: want initial results by EOD tomorrow.

ben: on it. iterating the query now. will kick off 120 labels + 40 control golden (from current golden set) so we can compute regression delta.

lina: for the golden update proposal i'd like to add a new metric to the golden metadata: `tokenizer_sensitivity_delta` (string: "low/med/high") and a short rationale field. keeps audits traceable.

olivia: also please add an automated smoke harness that runs the int3 vs baseline pair on the candidate batch and computes pass@k + exact match + compile-check (for code). sample command:
```bash
ai-eval harness run --models baseline,int3 --input candidates.jsonl --metrics pass@1,exact_match,compile_ok --save-diffs out/diffs.jsonl
```

deploy-bot: canary deployed: qbringup/int3-smoke v0.3 -> infra-quant (ap-south-1) :rocket:

marco: great. once ben has labels we should: 1) compute regression on control vs candidate, 2) inspect diffs for truncation vs hallucination, 3) decide if fallback to int4 or kernel tweak needed.

ben: labels enqueued. ETA results ~24h. i added a short labeling rubric: 
- PASS: expected code compiles & answers prompt
- FAIL-HALLU: plausible but incorrect
- FAIL-TRUNC: stopped mid-token/unfinished
- AMBIG: needs second opinion

olivia: can we also run a quick quant ablation where we toggle `kv_cache_alignment` and `attention_chunk` params? i suspect kernel alignment is causing extra token drops on long code blocks. small script:
```python
for a in [8,16]:
  for k in [true,false]:
    run_smoke(model='int3', attention_chunk=a, kv_cache_alignment=k)
```

lina: note — if this turns out to be tokenizer-sensitive, we should add post-quantization token remap pass in the compile pipeline as a short-term mitigation. create a small RFC issue and link audit results.

marco: agreed. action items summarized: 
- ben: run labeling (query + 120 labels + 40 control) (due 24h)
- olivia: run harness + ablation experiments (attention/kv) on same batch (due 24h)
- lina: draft golden metadata change + RFC for token-remap (due 48h)
- sara: add dedupe filter to selection SQL and help QA the query (today)

sara: will pair w/ ben on query tweaks. tagging @olivia for metric schema.

ben: tagged and kicked off job. will ping when first 30 labels are back. :hammer:

olivia: ping me on results channel — i'll start diff analysis and compile checks.

marco: thanks team. want a quick sync if results look bad — otherwise we'll decide fallback policy (int4 vs kernel fix). :+1:
